item.title: [New] SharePoint temporary-authentication (tempauth) URLs retire on 1 April 2027; Power Apps and flows that hand out pre-authenticated SharePoint links break
item.description:
Pre-authenticated SharePoint URLs are bearer links: anyone holding one downloads the file without signing in. Their retirement closes an exfiltration path; custom connectors that depend on them will fail.

Power Platform · Inventory custom Power Platform controls, actions and connectors that return or consume SharePoint tempauth URLs and move them to Entra ID tokens before 1 April 2027.

item.description:
Removes a reason users strip labels to annotate a PDF, but anyone holding edit usage rights on a label gains a new in-browser way to modify protected files, so label rights decide who can.

SharePoint · Check which labels grant EDIT or OWNER usage rights to broad groups before late January.

item.title: [Message Center] MC1545696 Microsoft OneDrive and SharePoint: Annotate sensitivity-label protected PDFs on the web
item.description:
OneDrive and SharePoint on the web will allow users with editing rights to annotate sensitivity-label protected PDFs without removing labels. Annotations and protections are preserved upon saving. This feature rolls out worldwide in late January 2027, requires no admin action, and applies only to OneDrive for Business and SharePoint.

item.title: [New] SharePoint Online and OneDrive web search becomes Copilot Search with AI summaries; general availability from mid-January 2027, deferrable per tenant and per site
item.description:
Search that summarises what a user can reach makes oversharing visible to more people faster; it does not change permissions.

SharePoint · Test custom search integrations and decide whether to defer at tenant or site level; pair with the new Data access governance report (MC1540348) to clean up oversharing first.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] SharePoint admin center gains a Data access governance report that lists every site a given group can reach and how far
item.description:
Broad or vendor groups that reach sensitive sites are the oversharing Copilot amplifies; the report answers 'what can this group see' without scripting.

SharePoint · Once it appears, run it for Everyone except external users, vendor groups and large dynamic groups, and fix the sites that should not be reachable before assigning more Copilot licences.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [Message Center] MC1540513 Microsoft SharePoint Online and OneDrive for the web: Updated search experience with Copilot Search
item.description:
SharePoint Online and OneDrive on the web are updating to a unified Copilot Search experience with natural-language prompts, AI summaries, and filters. Rollout starts mid-October 2026 (preview) and mid-January 2027 (general). Users can opt out during preview; minimal action required from organizations.

item.title: [Message Center] MC1540348 Microsoft SharePoint: Data access governance report for group permissions
item.description:
Microsoft SharePoint is introducing a Data access governance report in the admin center to help administrators identify sites accessible to specific groups and assess access levels. Rolling out worldwide from late November to early December 2026, it aids in managing permissions and preventing unintended content exposure.
